title: Ask Engram for a distinct refusal code when named_root_bind meets an inactive control session
outcome: TermAl recognizes Engram's inactive-control-session refusal of named_root_bind by a distinct code or structured field, not by matching the reason text inside named_root_binding_refused. The control-OFF re-bind flag therefore fires exactly for the case a session bind cures (the control session is exited), and not for actor mismatch, which shares the reason text today.
acceptance: Engram's owners have answered whether named_root_bind can report the inactive-session refusal (control_runtime.rs:107-113) with a distinct code or field, separately from its other named_root_binding_refused causes, and the answer is recorded on this item

if Engram provides one: TermAl's engram_named_root_refusal_remedy_locked keys on it instead of ENGRAM_INACTIVE_CONTROL_SESSION_REASON, with a test, reviewed and gated under the standing rule; if not, the coordinator records that the text match stays
